---
title: "Grab_txIDs_from_GeneID"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
## ---- packages ----
# install.packages(c("dplyr","readr"))           # if needed
# BiocManager::install("GenomicFeatures")        # if needed
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(GenomicFeatures)

## ---- inputs: your two columns of LOCs ----
# Replace this block with readr::read_tsv("your_two_col_file.tsv", col_names = c("streme5_spps","meme8_mad_bhlh"))
loc_pairs =
 as_tibble( read.csv("C:/Users/danie/OneDrive - Colostate/NIFA_PROJECT/Obj1/analysis/promoter_analysis/genome_gff/hlh_spps_kruppel-like_geneIDS.csv", header = T))

## ---- path to your GFF ----
gff_path = "C:/Users/danie/OneDrive - Colostate/NIFA_PROJECT/Obj1/analysis/promoter_analysis/genome_gff/GCF_020882245.1_ASM2088224v1_genomic.gff"  # <-- set this

## ---- build LOC -> XM mapping from the GFF via TxDb ----
txdb = loadDb("C:/Users/danie/OneDrive - Colostate/NIFA_PROJECT/Obj1/analysis/promoter_analysis/genome_gff/rpadi_V4_txdb.sqlite")

# Be tolerant of TxDb column name variants across versions
tx_cols   = columns(txdb)
tx_field  = intersect(c("TXNAME","tx_name"), tx_cols)[1]
gene_field= intersect(c("GENEID","gene_id"), tx_cols)[1]
stopifnot(!is.na(tx_field), !is.na(gene_field))

# Pull (transcript_name, gene_id) and coerce gene IDs to LOC-strings if needed
tx_map =
  AnnotationDbi::select(
    txdb,
    keys    = keys(txdb, keytype = tx_field),
    keytype = tx_field,
    columns = c(tx_field, gene_field)
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(
    gene_id = as.character(.data[[gene_field]]),
    loc     = ifelse(grepl("^LOC", gene_id), gene_id, paste0("LOC", gene_id)),
    xm_raw  = .data[[tx_field]]
  )

# --- build mapping: XM_ > XR_ > other; keep 'rna-' prefix for OmicsBox
loc_to_tx_first =
  tx_map %>%
  filter(!is.na(xm_raw), nzchar(xm_raw)) %>%
  mutate(
    tx_clean = sub("^rna-", "", xm_raw),
    priority = dplyr::case_when(
      grepl("^XM_", tx_clean) ~ 1L,
      grepl("^XR_", tx_clean) ~ 2L,
      TRUE                    ~ 3L
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(loc, priority, tx_clean) %>%
  group_by(loc) %>%
  summarise(tx_first = dplyr::first(tx_clean), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(tx_first = ifelse(is.na(tx_first), NA_character_, paste0("rna-", tx_first)))

# two renamed copies for clean joins (so we never rename in the main df)
map_streme = loc_to_tx_first %>% dplyr::rename(streme5_spps_XM = tx_first)
map_meme   = loc_to_tx_first %>% dplyr::rename(meme8_mad_bhlh_XM = tx_first)

# ensure join keys are clean character strings
loc_pairs = loc_pairs %>%
  mutate(
    across(where(is.factor), as.character),
    `streme.5...spps` = trimws(as.character(`streme.5...spps`)),
    `meme8...mad.bhlh` = trimws(as.character(`meme8...mad.bhlh`))
  )

# join (no post-join rename needed)
out =
  loc_pairs %>%
  left_join(map_streme, by = c("streme.5...spps" = "loc")) %>%
  left_join(map_meme,   by = c("meme8...mad.bhlh" = "loc"))

# quick sanity check
out %>% summarise(
  n_na_streme = sum(is.na(streme5_spps_XM)),
  n_na_meme   = sum(is.na(meme8_mad_bhlh_XM))
)


out_spps = out %>%
  dplyr::select(streme5_spps_XM)


out_mad_bhlh = out %>%
  dplyr::select(meme8_mad_bhlh_XM)


write.table(out_spps, file = "C:/Users/danie/OneDrive - Colostate/NIFA_PROJECT/Obj1/analysis/promoter_analysis/genome_gff/spps_kruppel-like_RNAIDS.txt", quote = F, col.names = F, row.names = F)
write.table(out_mad_bhlh, file = "C:/Users/danie/OneDrive - Colostate/NIFA_PROJECT/Obj1/analysis/promoter_analysis/genome_gff/mad_bHLH-like_RNAIDS.txt", quote = F, col.names = F, row.names = F)
```
